component.name: lynis2pdf
component.summary: Convert Lynis security-audit results into a PDF report

description.p: lynis2pdf reads the results of a Lynis (cisofy.com/lynis) system security audit and produces a professional PDF report. The report is enriched with related MITRE ATT&CK techniques and OWASP Top 10:2025 categories, an expanded configuration-hardening checklist, and ready-to-copy diagnostic commands for each finding.
Reports are intended for documentation, compliance evidence, archiving, and presenting results to clients or management.
